Changed the channel name: GA - Repeal "Microcredit And Microgrants"
Next up due to stream barriers being withdrawn
Don’t have an issue with this per se, but I wish the redundancy was made more explicit instead of simone doing the simone thing where he bases proposals on RL trends
There’s a solid case for repeal but the proposal stumbles over itself

I think a repeal of the target is completely justified, but I hate relying on RL trends and “many nations are saying” alleged IC trends that you can’t prove instead of the stronger redundancy/obsolescence argument you could be making

The frustrating part is there are hints of that stronger argument too, but “Taking the view that much of the recommendations of GAR 94 on the management of finances and entrepreneurship have been better articulated by GAR 474, GAR733 [sic] and other resolutions concerning personal finance;” is minimal
